Diablo 4 Warlock Leveling Build (Demonic Legion) Demonology Build Lord of Hatred Guide
In this Diablo 4 build guide, I'm going to be showing you the Legion Warlock build for Diablo 4. This is a Warlock build that focuses on using hordes of demons to take care of your enemies safely from range, without needing to get in close and personal. This build is effective and can reliably bring you through the story in the first tiers of torment to the end without much trouble.
